title: A sky underground?
content: I'll be as quick as I can. Me and some people took the crazy highway to a giant chapel/church but when you walk inside it's a giant park, you can see the sky and everything. There's also a church in the corner(this is a regular building with a roof). There's a pool and a little indoor pool far to the other side. The trippy part is I found a hole/small cave that was encrusted with a greenish crystal. It didn't go straight down but instead was at an angle you could walk or climb down. When I went in to inspect it the incline leads to a massive cliff edge with a full beach at the bottom, like the white cliffs in England(I have never been there). The rock walls were all made of the same crystal and there were lots crystals across the beach. I could look forward and see the ocean far as the eye can see and look up to see the sky... I thought about climbing down to the beach but instead went back to the park before asking a woman for some life advice. So this was an outside inside a building with an entire sky and beach underneath the ground..... I'll try to get back there and explore the beach. Has anyone else come across giant crystal rock walls at the end of a beach? It was like the white cliffs of Dover but underground.. but still outside....
